sections.Profile:
Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure , released by Williams in August 1993, is a four-player widebody machine with a dot-matrix display that retells the original Indiana Jones film trilogy, with four modes drawn from each film. Designed by Mark Ritchie and Doug Watson, it has the player find treasures, escape danger and brave the Path of Adventure, a raised mini-playfield tilted with the flipper buttons, on the way to the Eternal Life wizard mode.
